statusReason: Sub-phase 9.4.7 fixed the seeder idle-drain leak and 9.4.8 reran the sweeps on Modal (free-tier, 32-container waves) against the full 10-conversation LoCoMo corpus (1986 QA items) with a warm live-extraction cache (google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-it). Numbers supersede the 9.4.6 advisory-only baseline; the ladder now cleanly beats bm25only/recency/random on MRR and recall@5.
knownIssues: 9.4.6 baseline.json claimed Tier 3 contributes 0.0001 MRR lift (well below 0.05 threshold). That measurement was on the broken ladder with residual-working-buffer contamination. Post-9.4.7 seeder idle-drain fix + 9.4.8 Modal sweeps show Tier 3 actually contributes +0.0794 MRR lift when TIER2_TAU_GAP allows queries to reach it. The graph expansion is genuinely valuable; 9.4.6 couldn't see it through the bench-state noise.

Sweeps run via Modal per-knob-value parallelism (one container per grid point). Free-tier concurrency cap of 32 containers means 48-point sweeps run in two waves (~3-4 min wall-clock vs ~62 min serial per 9.4.6 retro).

Graph and consolidation sweeps remain deferred per 9.4.6 retro + 9.4.8 locked decision #6. With the ladder no longer structurally broken, these become meaningful follow-ups for a post-9.4.8 sub-phase (9.4.9 or Phase 11).

TIER2_TAU_CONFIDENCE.note: INERT on LoCoMo-10. Initial 48-point sweep proved this axis produces identical MRR across values 0.5-5.0 at any fixed TIER2_TAU_GAP (rank-1 Tier-2 BM25 scores always clear even low thresholds). Keep at spec default; candidate for removal in future sweeps.

TIER2_TAU_GAP.source: sweeps/2026-04-22-tau.md (+ extended/sledgehammer followups narrated in retro)
TIER2_TAU_GAP.note: AMENDED. Extended + sledgehammer sweeps (48-point → 8-point → 4-point) revealed MRR climbs monotonically from 0.7303 (gap=0.1) through 0.7721 (gap=1.5) to plateau at 0.8077 (gap=10) and stay flat through gap=1000. Tier 3 graph expansion becomes the dominant retrieval path at gap ≥ 10. +0.0625 absolute MRR lift vs spec default. Phase 11 candidate: Tier 2's confident-hit gating may be net-negative — ladder could simplify to always-Tier-3.

TAG_BOOST.note: ADVISORY. Sweep shows TAG_BOOST peaks at 3 (+0.0098 MRR absolute vs spec default, real non-flat signal). However the +0.0098 lift is redundantly absorbed by the TIER2_TAU_GAP=10 amendment (validation sweep at cb30323 landed at 0.8080, essentially matching gap=10 alone at 0.8077). Keeping at spec default 2 ships one-knob amendment rather than two.

SUBJECT_BOOST.note: INERT on LoCoMo-10. BM25 sweep showed <0.003 MRR variation across all values 1-4 (rounding noise). Keep at spec default.

headlineMetrics.skipReasonNote: Skipped QAs are those where no retrieved entry's provenance.sourceMessages intersected qa.evidenceTurns. Reflects retrieval misses, not corpus gaps (99.5% of LoCoMo QAs have non-empty evidenceTurns after the 9.4.6 Task 2 loader fix).

ladderVsRandom.note: Ladder MRR (0.7452) is +0.4762 vs random (0.2690). Post-9.4.7 ladder cleanly beats the random baseline.

ladderVsBm25Only.note: Ladder MRR (0.7452) is +0.0554 vs bm25only (0.6898). Scorer chain + Tier 3 graph expansion earn their keep.
